dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings on the posterior-dorsal flank exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with a high-contrast transition from the dark exterior fur to a thin, bright-intensity ring. The gradient shifts sharply back to a dark core at the center of each annulus. Several adjacent 'C' shaped structures show similar sharp, non-uniform light-colored edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge as small, isolated points of high luminance that lack an internal gradient or ring-like structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent posterior 'O' rings form a scalene triangle. A series of four smaller annuli located along the mid-lateral axis form an irregular, slightly curved linear chain.
